styleSelection.reason: Collegiate Gothic architectural watercolor where crisp dry-paper value planes, warm ashlar limestone washes, and selective sepia pen-and-ink carry the form.

Y1.sky.reason: Cerulean and granulating French ultramarine upper sky graded down to reserved cloud whites.

Y1.sunlit-gable.reason: Broad warm yellow-ochre and raw-sienna ashlar limestone facade and gable planes with crisp Gothic window tracery.

Y1.shaded-wings.reason: Cooler shaded stone return walls, chimney stacks, and connected ultramarine + raw sienna cast shadows.

Y1.slate-roofs.reason: Connected cool slate roof slopes and eave shadow lines.

Y1.courtyard-foliage.reason: Sunlit hansa-yellow, yellow-ochre, ultramarine, and sap-green deciduous courtyard trees and foreground street details.

families.referenceCue: Cerulean and French ultramarine upper sky graded into warm cream-white cloud corridors.
Cool grey-blue slate roof slopes on the central gable and right wing.
Sunlit golden-ochre and raw-sienna ashlar limestone central gable, pointed Gothic windows, medallion, and entrance arches.
Left stone wing, flanking chimney stack, and deep vertical cast-shadow recess.
Sunlit yellow-green deciduous tree in the lower-right courtyard beside the entrance portals.
